_comment: Lane declarations for the fast path (world/server/fast_path.py).
Each entry under 'lanes' needs a unique 'name' and a 'type' from the
audited registry: http_watch (GET-only observation; declare program +
targets as the scope) or paper_markets (simulated fills against public
spot prices; no order-placement code path exists).
Unknown types are rejected visibly at boot and never run.
Kill switch: create the file data/fast-kill to pause every lane.
Tune or add lanes here without touching code; a new KIND of behavior
is a code change and gets reviewed like one.

lanes.name: bounty-recon
lanes.analysis_prompt: You are a bug bounty recon analyst. Work only within the declared scope. Be concise: list anything unusual worth a human look, or say "nothing notable".
